goal.en: Report your missing suitcase, describe it clearly and leave your contact number.
goal.zh: 回報行李箱不見了，清楚描述外觀，並留下聯絡電話。

background: small hostel luggage storage room, metal shelves with numbered cubbies, one empty shelf space, a few backpacks and suitcases, wooden floor, warm ceiling lamp, evening

intro.en: Back at the hostel that evening, you go to the luggage room to get a jacket from your suitcase.
intro.zh: 傍晚回到旅館，你去行李室想從行李箱拿件外套。

intro.en: Your tag says shelf 27. Shelf 27 is empty.
intro.zh: 你的行李牌寫著 27 號架。27 號架是空的。

lines.en: Hey, Kai! You look worried. Is everything okay?
lines.zh: 嘿，凱！你看起來很擔心。一切還好嗎？

choices.en: Not really. My suitcase is missing.
choices.zh: 不太好。我的行李箱不見了。
choices.tip: My + 物品 + is missing. 是說東西不見時最清楚的說法。

choices.en: Not okay. My suitcase is not see!
choices.zh: 不好。我的行李箱不見了！

lines.en: Your suitcase can't see? Um... suitcases don't have eyes.
lines.zh: 你的行李箱看不見？嗯……行李箱沒有眼睛吧。

story.en: Nadia thinks it's a joke and laughs along. It takes ten minutes before anyone starts looking.
story.zh: 娜迪亞以為你在開玩笑，跟著笑了起來。過了十分鐘，才有人開始找。

fail.why: 「不見了」不能直譯成 not see。東西找不到要說 My suitcase is missing. 或 I can't find my suitcase.。

choices.en: No! Your hostel lost my suitcase. This is terrible!
choices.zh: 不好！你們旅館把我的行李箱弄丟了。太糟了！

lines.en: Whoa, okay. Let's not jump to conclusions. I'll get my manager.
lines.zh: 哇，好喔。先別急著下結論。我去找經理。

story.en: Twenty minutes of forms later, nobody has actually started looking for your suitcase.
story.zh: 填了二十分鐘的表格，還是沒有人真的開始找你的行李箱。

fail.why: 還沒確認狀況就怪對方，會讓人立刻進入防衛模式。先冷靜說明：My suitcase is missing. Could you help me?

lines.en: Oh no. Okay, can you describe it for me?
lines.zh: 糟糕。好，可以跟我描述一下它的樣子嗎？

choices.en: It's a black suitcase with a red ribbon on the handle.
choices.zh: 是一個黑色行李箱，提把上綁了紅色緞帶。
choices.tip: It's a + 顏色 + 物品 + with + 特徵，描述東西清楚又好找。

choices.en: It's very, very important to me. All my clothes are in it!
choices.zh: 它對我非常非常重要。我所有的衣服都在裡面！

lines.en: I'm sure it is. But what does it look like?
lines.zh: 我相信很重要。但它長什麼樣子？

story.en: Nadia searches for "a very important bag." Unfortunately, every bag in the room is very important to someone.
story.zh: 娜迪亞開始找「一個非常重要的包」。可惜這房間裡每個包對某人來說都很重要。

fail.why: describe 是要你說外觀：顏色、大小、特徵。可以說 It's a black suitcase with a red ribbon on the handle.。

choices.en: It's black color suitcase, it have a red ribbon.
choices.zh: 它是黑色的行李箱，它有一條紅色緞帶。

lines.en: Black, and... red ribbons? Lots of them? Let me look.
lines.zh: 黑色，還有……很多紅緞帶？我找找看。

story.en: Nadia comes back proudly holding a black gift box covered in red ribbons. It is definitely not your suitcase.
story.zh: 娜迪亞得意地拿回來一個綁滿紅緞帶的黑色禮物盒。那絕對不是你的行李箱。

fail.why: 英文說顏色不用加 color，a black suitcase 就好；主詞 it 後面要用 has，不是 have。可以說 It's a black suitcase with a red ribbon.。

lines.en: Got it. I'll check the cameras and ask the other guests. What's your contact number?
lines.zh: 了解。我會查監視器，也問問其他房客。你的聯絡電話是幾號？

choices.tip: 用 It's... 報電話號碼，順便說房號，對方更容易找到你。

choices.en: Can you add my LINE instead? It's easier.
choices.zh: 可以改加我的 LINE 嗎？比較方便。

lines.en: Your line? Sorry, what's that? Is it an app?
lines.zh: 你的 line？抱歉，那是什麼？是一個 app 嗎？

story.en: Nadia spends ten minutes trying to download an app she has never heard of. Then she gives up and writes "room 4?" on a sticky note.
story.zh: 娜迪亞花了十分鐘想下載一個她從沒聽過的 app，最後放棄，在便利貼寫下「4 號房？」。

fail.why: LINE 在台灣很普遍，但在很多英語國家幾乎沒人用。對方問 contact number，就直接給電話號碼：It's 555-0193.。

choices.en: I'm in room 4, top bunk by the window.
choices.zh: 我住 4 號房，靠窗的上鋪。

lines.en: Okay, but my shift ends soon. Do you have a phone number?
lines.zh: 好，但我快下班了。你有電話號碼嗎？

story.en: Your suitcase turns up at midnight, but the night staff can't reach you. You sleep in your clothes.
story.zh: 行李箱半夜找到了，但夜班人員聯絡不到你。你只好穿著衣服睡覺。

fail.why: contact number 是「聯絡電話」，對方要的是號碼，不是房號。要回答 It's 555-0193.，再補充房號會更好。

lines.en: Good news! Another guest took your suitcase by mistake. He's bringing it down now.
lines.zh: 好消息！另一位房客不小心拿錯了你的行李箱，他正要拿下來。

choices.en: No worries. It happens. I'm just glad it's back.
choices.zh: 沒關係，難免的。東西找回來就好。
choices.tip: No worries. It happens. 是接受道歉時大方又自然的回應。

choices.en: It's okay, it's okay. No relationship!

lines.en: No relationship? With... the other guest? Okay, I'll tell him.
lines.zh: 不要有關係？跟……那位房客嗎？好，我會轉告他。

story.en: Nadia tells the guest you want no relationship with him. He apologizes again, looking very confused.
story.zh: 娜迪亞轉告房客，說你不想跟他有任何關係。他一臉困惑地又道歉了一次。

fail.why: 「沒關係」不能直譯成 No relationship.，relationship 是人際或感情上的關係。接受道歉說 No worries. 或 That's okay. It happens.。

choices.en: He really should be more careful with other people's bags.
choices.zh: 他真的應該對別人的包包小心一點。

lines.en: Well... he did say sorry. Twice.
lines.zh: 呃……他已經道過歉了，兩次。

story.en: The guest hears you from the stairs and hands over your suitcase without a word. The lobby stays awkward all evening.
story.zh: 那位房客在樓梯上聽到了，一句話也沒說就把行李箱交給你。整晚大廳都很尷尬。

fail.why: 對方已經道歉，還繼續責備會顯得很不大方。英語圈常用 No worries. It happens. 輕鬆帶過。

lines.en: A tall guest hurries down the stairs with your suitcase, red ribbon and all.
lines.zh: 一位高個子房客提著你的行李箱匆匆下樓，紅緞帶還在上面。

lines.en: Here you go, Kai. Sorry about the scare!
lines.zh: 給你，凱。讓你虛驚一場了！

lines.en: See? The red ribbon saved the day.

story.en: Your suitcase is back, your jacket is warm, and you handled the whole thing calmly. Not bad for a day in a new city.
story.zh: 行李箱回來了，外套穿上了，整件事你處理得很冷靜。在陌生城市的一天，表現不錯。

notes.explain: 東西不見用 is missing，也可以說 I can't find my suitcase.。不要直譯「不見」成 not see。

example.en: Excuse me, my backpack is missing from the locker.
example.zh: 不好意思，我的背包從置物櫃裡不見了。

notes.en: It's a black suitcase with a red ribbon.
notes.zh: 是一個綁著紅緞帶的黑色行李箱。
notes.explain: 描述物品：a + 顏色 + 物品 + with + 特徵。顏色前面不用加 color，black color suitcase 是常見錯誤。

example.en: It's a small blue backpack with a cat keychain.
example.zh: 是一個掛著貓咪鑰匙圈的藍色小背包。

notes.explain: 被問 What's your contact number? 就給電話號碼。數字可以一個一個念，例如 five-five-five, oh-one-nine-three。

example.en: Can I leave my contact number? It's 555-0193.
example.zh: 我可以留聯絡電話嗎？是 555-0193。

notes.explain: 「沒關係」千萬不要說 No relationship.。接受道歉可以說 No worries.、That's okay. 或 It happens.。

example.en: Sorry I'm late! / No worries. It happens.
example.zh: 抱歉我遲到了！／沒關係，難免的。

notes.zh: 給電話號碼，不是給 LINE
notes.explain: LINE 在台灣、日本很普遍，但在很多英語國家幾乎沒人用。對方要聯絡方式時，先給電話號碼或 email 最保險。

example.en: Here's my number. You can also text me.
example.zh: 這是我的號碼，你也可以傳簡訊給我。
